element.description: The element the session belongs to

value.description: The id of the choice placed in each response area, keyed by the area's index

selector.description: How the learner gave the last response; the delivery writes `Mouse`

shuffledValues.description: Choice ids in the order they were shuffled for this learner, when choice order is not locked

audioStartTime.description: Timestamp (ms) when the prompt's auto-played audio started

audioEndTime.description: Timestamp (ms) when the prompt's auto-played audio ended

waitTime.description: Milliseconds the learner waited for the prompt's auto-played audio to finish
